dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.invite_help: Share this link in your company's Telegram group. Anyone who taps it joins your team — they just tap Start and type their name.
dashboard.no_username: Set TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME to show the invite link. Invite token: {{token}}

start.welcome_ask_name: 👋 Welcome to {{company}} on Telegram! This is where your manager sends your work tasks. You don't need to install anything or set anything up — when a task arrives, just tap a button on it. To finish joining, what's your name?
start.joined: ✅ Thanks, {{name}}! You're all set. Your tasks will appear here — there's nothing else to do for now, just wait for your first one.
start.already_joined: You're already set up, {{name}}. Type /today to see today's tasks.

error.invite_invalid: This invite link isn't valid. Please ask your manager for a new one.
error.invite_expired: This invite link has expired. Please ask your manager for a new one.
error.no_token: To join, tap the invite link your manager shared in your group.
error.unknown_user: I don't know you yet. Tap your company's invite link to join.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

hint.use_buttons: To update a task, tap its buttons. Type /help to see what I can do.
